mcq.question: Why is the naive nearest-driver scan kept after the grid index exists?

options.A: It is faster for large fleets
options.B: The grid needs it to build cells
options.C: It is the reference that the fast version is cross-checked against

mcq.explanation: An obviously correct slow version is the cheapest way to test a clever fast one.

mcq.question: When can the ring search stop?

options.A: As soon as any driver is found
options.C: When the closest possible point in the next ring is further than the best driver found
options.D: When the ring has no drivers

mcq.explanation: A closer driver could sit just across a cell border, so the bound must be checked before stopping.

bonus.question: When would a k-d tree or an R-tree be better than a uniform grid for drivers in a city?
Add `k_nearest(x, y, k)` to the grid and cross-check it against sorting all drivers by distance.
